blockingFindings.summary: 99 of 127 submittable prompts use negative-form language despite the binding affirmative-prompt requirement; 29 use parenthetical negative exclusions, 8 use 'never', and 1 uses 'without'.
No production validator or adversarial test rejects negative-form prompt language, so the author evidence overclaims affirmative compliance.
